result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but one section heading displays a raw localization key instead of translated text. No other layout or styling defects are apparent; the partially visible carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The section heading above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for 'home_feed.popular_title' to the locale files (or fix the key reference) and add a fallback so untranslated keys never render to users.
